_about: Iso lighting (iso/scripts/iso_lighting.gd). Two times of day and two quality tiers. The rule the numbers serve: the world is cold and grey, fire is the only warm, strong colour, and a body is never a black cut-out (ambient floor + the character rim). HIGH spends on volumetric fog, SDFGI bounce, SSAO + SSIL, TAA and soft shadows; LOW keeps the identity with plain depth fog, no GI and fewer shadows. Fog: an iso lens sits 40-60 m from everything, so distance fog washes the whole picture; the haze hugs the ground instead — height fog on LOW, a FogVolume over the map on HIGH, which the fires light up. Shadow distance is measured from the lens, which in iso stands 30-60 m from the ground it looks at: anything shorter and the ground under the player has no sun shadows at all.

character_light._about: A soft light that travels with Aras (Diablo's light radius): it lifts him off a dark road and gives the ground around him form at night. Cool by day, a touch warmer at night (the ember he carries).
